Method

How the experiment works

Six validation candidates
Weighted quantile, tree, Elastic Net, Huber and adaptive no-change candidates are compared against the fixed no-change benchmark.
Honest timing
Each rolling forecast trains only on targets whose assumed publication date is no later than the forecast date. HS codes are never pooled.
Calibrated uncertainty
Pre-test residuals provide split-conformal calibration, while forecast-origin volatility adaptively scales the distribution. Quantiles are monotonically ordered after prediction.

Specification deviation: this improved experiment uses ONS ERUC as the added external metal-inflation feature. It does not include the specification's World Bank aluminium/nickel or USGS titanium-sponge inputs. Results therefore assess the approved ERUC feature substitution, not literal full-spec compliance.
